description.en: Shows the Fighting Spirit presentation (jingle J_07, message "sysmes-Avatar-00001" naming the character and the spirit) without attaching anything. The story uses it when the spirit is already set up by other means, for example during a match (CMND_BTL_SET_AVATER).
Parameter ID of the character, e.g. "para_cp0008".
true to lock the character's Fighting Spirit afterwards (CMND_SET_AVATAR_LOCK_FLAG(hdl, true)); otherwise the lock state it had before is kept.

examples.case: Announcing a Fighting Spirit in a match scene (real usage, from ev44030040.nut)
